title: Section-element ordinary open counit compatibility
statement: For X, Y, h, U, M and W as in the sectionwise ordinary open counit compatibility, every section element x of the source module on W has equal images under the two displayed composite maps.

source.place: Tag 08FE and Tag 08BV, sectionwise restriction and counit calculation

proof.text: Expand the underlying section maps definitionally. The composition comparison followed by the Y open counit becomes M.val.presheaf.map applied twice, as does the restriction comparison followed by the X open counit. Rewrite both nested applications using ConcreteCategory.comp_apply and Functor.map_comp. Both composite arrows have identical endpoints in the opposite category of opens, so thinness identifies them; congruence proves equality on x. This uses only the concrete comparison definitions and Mathlib functoriality, not the parent square.

proof_origin.document: Stacks Project, Cohomology of Sheaves, Tags 08FE and 08BV
proof_origin.note: R4: direct Lean proof by definitional reduction to presheaf restriction maps, functoriality, and thinness; removes the cyclic reference to the parent square.

theorem schemeMVOrdinaryOpenCounit_square_section_element
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (h ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
    (W : (U.toScheme : Scheme).Opensᵒᵖ)
    (x : (((schemeOpenRestriction Y U).obj
      ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (h ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙
        RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj M)).val.obj W)) :
    (((schemeOpenRestriction Y U).map
        ((schemeMVUnderivedOpenComposition h U).hom.app M) ≫
        (schemeOpenModuleAdjunction Y U).counit.app
          ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (h ∣_ U).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj M)).val.app W) x =
      (((schemeMVUnderivedOpenRestriction h U).hom.app
          ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (h ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj M) ≫
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (h ∣_ U).toLRSHom.toShHom).map
          ((schemeOpenModuleAdjunction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U)).counit.app M)).val.app W) x
